sql.if: SELECT i.id, i.list_id, i.movie_id, i.content_type, i.added_at, i.watched_at, c.title, c.poster_url AS cover, c.alias, c.year, c.score_douban AS rating, c.score_douban_count, c.score_imdb_count, c.score_rt_critic_count, c.score_rt_audience_count, c.region, c.genre, c.director, c.writer, c.actor, c.release_date, c.duration, NULL AS total_episode, i.rating AS user_rating, i.note FROM user_movie_list_item i JOIN movie c ON c.id = i.movie_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.list_id = #{listId} AND i.content_type = 'movie'
